text:
This tool is genuinely impressive... it might actually replace my keyboard for daily typing (unless I'm gaming). 🐸

VoiceGecko is a free, open-source voice dictation tool that converts your speech into text seamlessly.

Just press a keyboard shortcut, start talking, and watch the text appear instantly.

Since it runs completely locally on your computer, your transcripts and data never leave your device.

My fingers are definitely getting a much-needed break. 😂

Link: voicegecko.dev
